Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Entrepreneurship 5.3Marketing of Goods and Services (6 lessons) By the end of th
Topic 5.4: Distribution of Goods and Services

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Distribution of Goods and Services. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Distribution of Goods and Services
2. Practise Distribution of Goods and Services at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Distribution of Goods and Services

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Distribution of Goods and Services
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Distribution of Goods and Services. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Distribution of Goods and Services at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Distribution of Goods and Services at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Distribution of Goods and Services
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Distribution of Goods and Services. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Distribution of Goods and Services using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Distribution of Goods and Services in the examples.
2. Explain Distribution of Goods and Services to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Distribution of Goods and Services.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Distribution of Goods and Services using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Distribution of Goods and Services important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Distribution of Goods and Services
2. Practise Distribution of Goods and Services at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Distribution of Goods and Services

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
